column1: # Golden cases for the Chinese G2P tone-sandhi module (data/zh_g2p).
# Format: <bucket> TAB <input> TAB <expected>.   Lines starting with # are comments.
# Token contract: syllable = pinyin letters + tone digit 1-5 (5 = neutral),
# "|" = word boundary from the segmenter, single space between tokens.
# Most cases are cross-checked against the reference implementation in
# records the three places where we deliberately differ; see docs/zh_g2p_sandhi.md.
# --- third-tone sandhi, inside one word (left-branching: all but the last drop to T2)
# --- third-tone sandhi, across word boundaries (right-branching: scan right to left)
# --- things that must NOT trigger third-tone sandhi
# --- "yi" that must keep its citation tone (ordinal prefix, word-final, dates, 一对一)

column2: jue2 de5 | bu4 tai4 | dui4 jin4
column3: jue2 de5 bu2 tai4 dui4 jin4

column1: # --- X-bu-Y: medial "bu" in a three-syllable word reads neutral
# --- erhua: word-final "er" reads neutral, except the reference must_not_er_words
# --- "a" particle assimilation (segmental, driven by the preceding final)
# --- interjection tone driven by the following punctuation
# interjection punctuation rule matches only standalone a5 (啊？/啊！), not ma5/la5/ba5 (吗/啦/吧)

column2: xiang3 liao2 shen2 me5 dou1 ke2 yi3 | o5 !
column3: xiang3 liao2 shen2 me5 dou1 ke2 yi3 | o5 !

column2: xiang3 liao2 shen2 me5 dou1 ke2 yi3 | wa5 !
column3: xiang3 liao2 shen2 me5 dou1 ke2 yi3 | wa5 !

column1: # --- deliberate divergences from the reference implementation.
# The reference blocks these via hanzi-keyed word lists (不字 / 一是 / 一加). At the pinyin
# level those keys are ambiguous, and blocking them would break the far more common
# 不自(量力) bu2 zi4, 一世/一事/一时 yi2 shi4, and 一家 yi4 jia1. 一加 (brand) is handled
# upstream via hanzi yi_exceptions in frontend_rules, not via blanket jia1 in YI_KEEP.
